paper.title: MBA-SLAM: Motion Blur Aware Gaussian Splatting SLAM

adoption.rationale: The only surveyed project implementing the paper's exact motion-blur-aware dense visual SLAM method; all higher-star projects are general Gaussian-splatting SLAM or deblurring variants.
